name: htsdk
description: HexTelegram SDK, build custom agents + plugins for HexTelegram

scripts.test: node -e "(async () => { const s = require('./index.js'); require('./plugin.js'); require('./auth-providers.js'); const f = s.definePlugin(() => ({ commands: { hi: async () => {} } })); await f({}); const r = await s.testPlugin('./examples/hello-plugin.js', 'echo', 'hi'); if (!r.ok || r.replies[0] !== 'hi') throw new Error('testPlugin failed'); console.log('htsdk ok'); })().catch((e) => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
